record.oneLiner: REST Web API for reading and writing Airtable bases, tables and records, with an official hosted MCP server.
record.verdictReason: Personal access tokens are created at /create/tokens with no plan requirement stated, and OAuth integrations are registered at /create/oauth with no vendor review step described. The Web API covers records and base metadata, so breadth is broad.

evidence.quote: Personal access tokens act as your user account, and should not be shared with third-party services or integrations.
From /create/tokens, click the “Create new token” button to create a new personal access token.
The API closely follows REST semantics
